import openpyxl
fn='inputs/Proteomic_data .xlsx'
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(fn, read_only=True, data_only=True)
ws=wb['Tumor vs Normal']
rows=ws.iter_rows(values_only=True)
header=next(rows)
print(header)
idx={h:i for i,h in enumerate(header)}
for r in rows:
    vals=[r[idx.get(c)] for c in ['gene','protein','log2FC','FC','Ratio','p.value','adj.Pval','is_sig']]
    gene=r[idx['gene']]
    desc=r[idx['Description']]
    if gene=='ENO1' or (desc and 'ENO1' in str(desc)) or (r[0]=='ENO1') or (str(r[0]).upper()=='ENO1'):
        print(vals, desc)
PY"
